workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(hand-spelled-instance-paths) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: Each heartbeat pulse of base's shim — an event that already fires. The probe reads class-space source, so it needs no runtime event of its own; what it must not do is invent a clock.
watchme.enough: The count of hand-spelled instance-space paths outside the resolver has stood at its floor across three consecutive pulses that each actually EXERCISED the scan, AND the floor is accounted for name by name — today that floor is 1 (the dispositioned inference_domain site). A zero-on-an-unscanned-tree is the vacuous green this field refuses, so the probe carries the scanned file count with the finding and an empty scan is a RED, not a green. Written against the lesson from device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim, whose first 'enough' described a state that produces no fire: this one is asked after each pulse, not only after a difference.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier measure (b), carrying the count, the named sites, and the number of files scanned.
watchme.nexus: cairn/tools/base's own history and state; the finding also deposits to the build_inspector failures corpus that already reads base's probes.
watchme.consumer: Akien, at his gate. An eleventh hand-spelled path is a spec-level fact about whether reason (II) is holding, not a defect the probe may dispose. The probe carries no authority (Law 6).

chart.why: THE `chart` DISSOLUTION, named by a hand because no rename record can name it (ticket a-bulk-move-forwards-itself-from-gits-own-rename-record, gate 3). The chart machine came apart on 2026-08-13: its 40 files went to skills/chart, seven builder machines under cairn/devices/builder/machines, cairn/tools/chain, cairn/tools/tree and skills/moreabout — no plurality, which is why the derivation correctly answers nothing and a hand must. skills/chart is the successor because the component's CHARTER moved there whole and now covers the skill AND the chain it calls: 'There is no separate device charter: the chart machine dissolved on 2026-08-13 and its charter moved here whole.' A reader following this ref wanted the design record, and that is where it is.
